introHtml: Green address books offer a subtle way to align your brand with environmental values. Whether you choose a rich forest shade or a soft sage, these books stand out on any desk. Perfect for tradeshow giveaways or employee gifts, they pair well with a stylus for convenient note-taking. Our selection includes durable options like the Original Tally Book and the Wire-O Flexible Tally Book, both available in green.
